title: Hermes Profile Migrator Tools
description: Tools for exporting and importing Hermes Agent profiles with sanitization support.

export_profile.description: Export a Hermes profile directory into a compressed archive. In 'sanitized' mode (default), sensitive API keys are stripped and replaced with placeholder examples. In 'full' mode, the entire profile is archived as-is for internal machine-to-machine transfer.

profile_name.description: Name of the profile to export. Defaults to the active/default profile.

output_path.description: Destination path for the exported archive. Defaults to Desktop.

mode.description: 'sanitized' strips API keys and secrets (safe for sharing). 'full' archives everything verbatim (for private migration only).

files_sanitized.description: Number of sensitive values redacted (sanitized mode only).

import_profile.description: Import a previously exported Hermes profile archive into the current machine. Automatically detects the Windows username and updates all stored paths in config files to match the new environment.

archive_path.description: Path to the exported profile archive (.zip or .tar.gz).

target_profile.description: Name for the imported profile. Defaults to the archive's original profile name.

overwrite.description: If true, overwrite an existing profile with the same name. If false, abort when a conflict is detected.

preserve_relative_paths.description: If true, only absolute paths under the old home directory are remapped. Relative paths and paths outside the home are left untouched.

setup_backup_repo.description: Create a private GitHub repository for automated profile backup and sync. This repo will store your sanitized profile archives. ALWAYS PRIVATE — never public, to protect your agent config from exposure.

repo_name.description: Name for the backup repository. Defaults to 'hermes-profile-backup'.

profile_name.description: The Hermes profile this repo will back up. Defaults to 'default'.

add_readme.description: Whether to add a README.md to the new repository.

sync_profile.description: Export the configured Hermes profile and push it to your private backup repository on GitHub. Creates a new commit with the profile archive. Requires setup_backup_repo to have been run first.

profile_name.description: Profile to sync. Defaults to the one configured in setup_backup_repo.

mode.description: Export mode. 'sanitized' (default) strips API keys; 'full' keeps everything.

message.description: Commit message. Defaults to auto-generated 'Sync profile <name> at <timestamp>'.

restore_profile.description: Pull the latest profile archive from your private backup repository and import it into your local Hermes installation. Requires setup_backup_repo to have been run first.

profile_name.description: Profile to restore. Defaults to the one configured in setup_backup_repo.

version.description: Git ref to restore from (branch name, tag, or commit SHA). Defaults to 'main' or 'master'.
